read.en: Alphabet slipped 0.3% on Nov 2 to $278.99, trading between $278.87 and $287.00 on 1.5 times average volume and closing near the low. It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($297.6), 10-day ($312.4), 30-day ($334.7), 200-day ($340.4) and 100-day ($344.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($322.47), and RSI is 21, oversold.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月2日小跌 0.3%，收于 $278.99，盘中区间 $278.87–287.00，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍，收于日内低点附近。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$297.6）、10 日（$312.4）、30 日（$334.7）、200 日（$340.4）和 100 日均线（$344.8）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$322.47），RSI 为 21，处于超卖。

read.en: A rebound to $287.0 stalled under the Oct 29 high ($288.3) and faded; no written level broke. Resistance is $283.1–288.3 (Oct 30, Nov 2 and Oct 29 highs), then $294.1–297.6 (Mar 9 and Feb 17 lows, 5-day) and $314.9–316.6 (bottom of the Oct 29 gap). Support is $275.2–276.9, then $270.7–272.1 (52-week low) and $257.3. A close above $288.3 would target $295–298; below $270.7, $257.
